value.signature: fn check_enumeration (& self , rows : & Collected < '_ > , children : & [Vec < usize >] , meter : & mut AuditMeter ,) -> Result < () , AuditFailure >

exception.justification: Justified: Memory audit adapter work inherits the enclosing metered audit operation.

review.body: { for row in & rows . results { let site = result_location (row . scope , row . identity) ; meter . visit (site) ? ; if self . scopes . get (& row . scope) . is_none () { return Err (meter . refused (StorageError :: CorruptHistory , site)) ; } meter . visit (site) ? ; if self . results . get (& (row . scope , row . identity)) . is_none () { return Err (meter . refused (StorageError :: CorruptHistory , site)) ; } } self . audit_pages (rows , children , meter) ? ; Ok (()) }
review.item_premise: The memory adapter is private to the bounded audit. It reads immutable retained tree records and shares the one audit meter and failure outcome under the enclosing public operation.
